race.comment: LIM'S SHAVANO (15) made a strong return here last month when just missing in what has proven a red-hot form reference. Found himself in a tricky spot at the Gold Coast when doing his best work late, then was good last time when racing closer to the speed. Should be hitting his straps now and gets in well with Pozman's claim. Inside draw should give him a great look. PERFECT PLAY (1) was dominant as a well-supported favourite at Doomben, putting a good gap to TWISTED QUEEN. Loves the mile and has enough dash to offset the wide draw. Will be in this for a long way. SIR WINNIE (14) disappointed as favourite last start, but his track-and-trip win, strong jockey record and third-up position give him a clear rebound case. HELL TO PAY (5) has been building and should be near his top now. Is another that can inject some pace.

Live1.SchedulerNote: *P1 [Metropolitan] Meeting Transferred, Doomben to Eagle Farm
